item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Pasta Bolognese – A deep and rich Italian meat sauce of minced beef simmered slowly with root vegetables, tomatoes and garlic. Served with al dente pasta and grated parmesan on top. (1+6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Pulled Pork BBQ Bowl – Slow-roasted, tender pulled pork tossed in a smoky BBQ sauce with garlic. Served with fluffy rice, a crisp cabbage and carrot salad and corn. (11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Soy Protein BBQ Bowl – Slow-cooked, tender pulled soy protein tossed in a smoky BBQ sauce with garlic. Served with fluffy rice, a crisp cabbage and carrot salad and corn. (7+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Pan-fried breaded pork patties (karbonade) with creamy parsley sauce, boiled potatoes and pickles. (1+2+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mushroom patty with creamy parsley sauce, boiled potatoes and pickles. (1+2+6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Moroccan-inspired chicken thigh with couscous tabbouleh with fresh greens and dried fruit. Served with mint yoghurt. (1+6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pan-fried marinated aubergine with couscous tabbouleh with fresh greens and dried fruit. Served with mint yoghurt. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Pad Thai with pork – Classic stir-fried rice noodles with tender pork, scrambled egg, bean sprouts and chives in a sweet-and-sour tamarind and pad thai sauce. Served with crushed peanuts and a fresh lime wedge. (2+3+4+7) GREEN DISH: Dish Pad Thai with tofu – Classic stir-fried rice noodles with tender tofu, scrambled egg, bean sprouts and chives in a sweet-and-sour tamarind and pad thai sauce. Served with crushed peanuts and a fresh lime wedge. (2+4+7)
